data.name: Bhavar
data.gender_notes: Bhavar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhavar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bhav' which means 'to be'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to have the ability to experience and express deep emotions. In Hindu mythology, Lord Bhavar is the deity who represents feelings and emotions. The name Bhavar carries the meaning “Lord of Feeling” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhavar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of feeling and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhavar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Bhavar embodies this belief, reflecting the significance of experiencing and expressing emotions fully and deeply. This name is often given to children who are believed to have an innate capacity to feel and express emotions, fostering a deep appreciation for the power and importance of emotions in life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Bhavar holds deep significance as it reflects the essence of human consciousness. It signifies the capacity to be present in the moment, fully experiencing the joy, sorrow, love, and loss that life brings. By embracing the full spectrum of emotions, we connect more deeply with ourselves, others, and ultimately, with the divine.
